crossRefs.note: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then…
The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!
So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him, and cursed as he went, threw…
He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand…
David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him; for who can stretch out his hand against Yahweh’s anointed, and be…

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel

translations.web: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh’s anointed?”
translations.bsb: But Abishai son of Zeruiah said, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
translations.kjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?
translations.asv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Jehovah's anointed?
